query: Let `F ⊣ G : C ⥤ D` be an adjunction equipped with Grothendieck topologies `J` on `C` and `K` on `D`. Then `F` is cocontinuous from `J` to `K` (every `K`-cover of `F U` pulls back to a `J`-cover of `U`) if and only if `G` preserves covers from `K` to `J` (every `K`-cover of `X` is sent by `G` to a `J`-cover of `G X`).
